name: Electromagnetic Industries
old_description: Our switchgear and motor control products help you power through any situation by supplying quality motor control performance and top-notch switchgear protection. Keeping you in control of your business at all times.
about:
Electromagnetic Industries operates from Bartlett, Illinois, where it has served customers for decades as a family-owned manufacturer of instrument transformers and electronic modules. The company emphasizes its U.S.-based production and a culture built around family, employees, and clients.

The product line centers on low-voltage current transformers for metering, protection, and relay applications; potential transformers for accurate voltage measurement and isolation; and electronic modules for arc-fault detection and motor control. These components are designed for switchgear, motor control centers, data centers, solar farms, and broader industrial power systems. Manufacturing is described as electronic manufacturing solutions, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers span the switchgear, motor control, data center, solar energy, and general industrial sectors. The company positions its transformers and electronics as critical for scaling high voltage and current to standardized levels for measuring instruments and protective relays, with applications in low-voltage power distribution and renewable energy installations.

Electromagnetic Industries highlights its "Made in USA" sourcing, warranty-backed products, and a legacy of integrity rooted in family ownership. The firm states that its electronic manufacturing solutions aim to optimize performance and protect power systems, though specific differentiators such as lead times or tolerance capabilities are not published.

name: Electronic Interconnect
old_description: We specializes in the design, supply, and manufacture of high-end PCBs for various industries. The company focuses on Printed Circuit Board Fabrication and Turnkey Services, High Quality, Low Cost, Fast Delivery, and Easy Ordering for customers across The United States of America.
about:
Electronic Interconnect (EI) operates from a single facility in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, where it has fabricated printed circuit boards for more than 30 years. The company does not disclose a precise founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials.

EI produces rigid PCBs ranging from single-layer prototypes to 58-layer advanced designs, with board thicknesses from 0.006″ to 0.390″. Standard capabilities cover 1–36 layers, trace/space down to 3.5/3.5 mil, finished hole sizes to 8 mil, and copper weights of 1–6 oz; advanced tiers push to 2/2 mil trace/space, 6 mil holes, and 10 oz copper. The shop offers HDI laser micro vias, controlled impedance, blind/buried vias, back drilling, heavy copper, hybrid RF/digital stack-ups, metal-clad thermal substrates, and a full menu of surface finishes including ENIG, ENEPIG, immersion tin, and selective gold. Electrical test, free DRC/DFM, and engineering support for SMT panel layout round out the service.

The customer base spans aerospace and defense (AS9100D, ITAR registration), medical devices (ISO 13485 compliance), telecommunications, industrial controls, and contract electronics assembly. Testimonials cite long-term relationships with surge-protection equipment makers, Hangstrom Electronics, Artisan Control Group, and Azimuth, with several accounts exceeding 15 years. EI reports over 1,000 active customers worldwide.

The company emphasizes same-day prototype turns, a 98.5 % on-time delivery rating, and a “make it right” guarantee.

The company designs and manufactures a range of handheld electrical testing equipment and diagnostic tools. Its product lines include relay testers such as the Super Relay Buddy and Universal Relay Buddy, digital multimeters, clamp meters, current probes, test lead kits, infrared thermometers, and training books. Electronic Specialties serves the automotive, small engine, HVAC, and industrial sectors. Its tools are used by automotive and industrial technicians for diagnosing circuits, batteries, engines, and other electrical components. The company markets directly to technicians and through distribution channels.

The company emphasizes its broad product line and dedicated support team as key differentiators, noting that it holds industry awards and patents for innovative, time-saving products. Free shipping is offered on orders over $75.

name: Electronic Supply
old_description: Electronic Supply is Kansas City’s trusted distributor for electrical connectors, wiring products, cable assemblies, and tools. Serving professionals in telecom, industrial, and OEM markets since 1952.
about:
Electronic Supply, based in Lenexa, Kansas, has operated as a low-voltage distributor since 1952. The company began as a supplier of electrical connectors, wiring products, cable assemblies, and tools for the Kansas City market.

Today the firm stocks a broad range of low-voltage products including data cabling and connectivity, switches, racks, backup power systems, cooling solutions, security cameras, access control hardware, audio-visual equipment, and installation materials. Its service portfolio covers systems design, print take-offs, RCDD drawing approval, subassembly and kitting, custom fabrication, product selection, project staging, and free local delivery in the Kansas City metro area. An on-staff Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) supports design and approval workflows, while the build group handles office networks, video surveillance, access control, backup power, and wireless access installations.

Electronic Supply serves government agencies, educational institutions, surveillance integrators, data networking and data center operators, and healthcare facilities, as well as telecom, industrial, and OEM customers. The company emphasizes compliance and efficiency for government projects, modern learning environments for schools, asset protection for surveillance, scalable infrastructure for data networks, and dependable solutions for healthcare.

The company cites its mission to simplify projects through integrity, reliability, and innovation, backed by long-standing vendor relationships that ensure quality products and on-time delivery. Differentiators include BICSI certification with an RCDD on staff, status as a Schneider Electric Elite Partner for APC and IT solutions, and a commitment to free local delivery, kitting, and assembly services that reduce project complexity.

old_description: Since 1992, ETS has been at the forefront of audio surveillance, providing reliable, cutting-edge solutions tailored to meet the needs of security integrators and other industries. With 32 years of experience, our expertise and dedication make us a trusted choice.
about:
Electronic Technical Services (ETS) was founded in 1992 in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company began as a provider of audio surveillance solutions tailored to security integrators and has since expanded its offerings across multiple industries.

ETS operates as an OEM manufacturer and electronics contract manufacturer, producing a wide range of Sound Surveillance™ equipment including microphones, speakers, interfaces, speaker-mics, base stations, surveillance kits, IP device kill switches, access control systems, audio playback devices, and breakout boards. The company also provides engineering services and custom product development, taking projects from concept through final production. While facility size and headcount are not disclosed, ETS emphasizes a broad product selection and the ability to design custom solutions for specific applications.

The company serves a diverse set of industries: athletics, banking, commercial, education, healthcare, law enforcement, manufacturing, public safety, retail, science and research, self-service (including parking kiosks and ATMs), transportation, and weigh scales. Customers include security integrators, self-service kiosk manufacturers, fleet operators, educational institutions, and government agencies.

ETS states that its differentiation lies in a customer-driven innovation model: when standard products do not fit, the company partners with clients to develop custom solutions, many of which become standard offerings. It also highlights the industry’s largest selection of audio surveillance equipment, integration with IP and PoE devices, and long-term reliability with virtually no maintenance.

name: Elektrisola Inc
old_description: Elektrisola specializes in fine enamelled wire diameters, starting with 0.008 mm (8 microns), and going up to a diameter of 0.50 mm. Beside the standardized diameters a big variety of special diameters is produced according to customer’s specification. Bare wire tolerances are very important in enamelled wire as they have direct impact on the resistance what again determines the variance of the final coil resistance.
about:
Elektrisola Inc operates from Boscawen, New Hampshire, as the North American hub of a global wire manufacturer with 10 plants across seven countries on three continents and 20 sales offices in 11 countries. The company focuses on fine enamelled wire, selfbonding wire, Litz wire, and fully insulated wire.

The company produces enamelled wire in diameters from 0.008 mm (8 microns) up to 0.50 mm, with custom diameters available to customer specifications. Its processes include dual enamel applicators for insulation and bondcoat, extrusion coatings with low melting points, silver coating, and a multiple-coating process for fully insulated wire that guarantees defect-free insulation. Litz wire is manufactured with taping, extrusion, and serving, while trailing cables and microcables are built for maximum flexibility and low friction.

Elektrisola serves the renewable energy, automotive, medical, and IT industries. In automotive, its Litz wire is used in EV components, inductive high-frequency components for charging stations, coil components for electric motors, and wireless charger components compliant with the Qi standard. For high-voltage applications, the VDE-certified EFOLIT product family meets stringent safety demands. Medical and IT systems also rely on the company's fine wire and cable constructions.

old_description: Wouldn't a quality, exterior hand railing or fencing be a nice addition to enhance your property? How about updating your interior railings? We give free estimates and offer a variety of designs and styles. Or work with one of our CAD designers to create a unique and totally custom design for your home. Contact us for your next project!
about:
Elsmere Ironworks has operated from Elsmere, Kentucky, since 1958. The family-owned shop was purchased in 2023 by Ryan Work from longtime owners John and Dan Goderwis, continuing a legacy of custom ornamental ironwork for the Tri-State region.

The company fabricates exterior and interior railings, estate gates, fencing, balconies, window boxes, wine gates, and security features for windows and doors. Its workshop combines old-world forging techniques with modern welding, powder coating, custom faux finishes, and hot-dipped galvanizing. A showroom allows clients to review samples and collaborate with CAD designers on custom projects.

Elsmere Ironworks serves residential and commercial customers across Greater Cincinnati, Northern Kentucky, and Southern Indiana. Homeowners request railings, gates, and decorative accents, while commercial projects include security installations and architectural metalwork.

The firm emphasizes durable finishes — powder coating baked in an oven for ten times the durability of paint, and hot-dipped galvanizing rated for 70-plus years of corrosion resistance — backed by a one-year paint warranty. It also stresses on-time delivery and free estimates.

name: EnTech Plastics, Inc.
old_description: We solve challenges. If you’re struggling with nonconforming parts we’re here to resolve your issues. We’ll determine the root cause of your problem and, with our engineering expertise and state-of-the art technology, we’ll make the required tooling or processing changes to consistently manufacture parts that meet your demanding requirements. We manufacture parts that other molders have trouble running. Let us solve your challenges!
about:
EnTech Plastics, Inc. operates from a 45,000-square-foot facility in Corry, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1996, the company has built its reputation on solving difficult molding challenges that other suppliers cannot.

The shop specializes in low- to mid-volume custom injection molding on machines ranging from 44 to 1,100 tons, producing parts from 1 gram up to 22 pounds. Core processes include gas-assist, insert molding, over molding, and master unit die (MUD) frames, supported by closed-loop controllers, SPC monitoring, and real-time production tracking. The facility dedicates 25,000 square feet to manufacturing and 20,000 square feet to warehousing with nine loading docks. Engineering services cover design for manufacturability, tool building, resin selection (including high-temperature grades such as PEI, PPS, and PEEK), and full assembly.

Customers span heavy-duty truck, medical, industrial, and consumer markets. EnTech has produced large components such as truck body panels, medical device housings, industrial machinery covers, and consumer product parts. Long-term clients include ANDRITZ Pulp & Paper and other OEMs that moved work to EnTech after experiencing inconsistent quality from larger molders.

The company positions itself on the intersection of low volume and high tonnage—a combination that is rare in the industry—and on delivering parts that are both aesthetically precise and mechanically robust. Its stated differentiator is the willingness to take on problematic tooling or nonconforming parts, diagnose root causes, and re-engineer the process to achieve consistent output.

name: Encore Wire Corporation
old_description: Encore Wire is a Texas-based manufacturer of building wire and copper cable. Products serve the residential, commercial and industrial construction markets, offering various types of UL-rated copper electrical wire.
about:
Encore Wire Corporation operates a 3.5 million-square-foot campus in McKinney, Texas. The company was founded in 1989 and manufactures building wire and copper cable for residential, commercial, and industrial construction markets.

The company engineers, manufactures, and ships UL-rated copper electrical wire from its Texas facility, which houses a dedicated quality control lab known as the Encore Wire TechLab®. Its product line includes building wire and copper cable, supplemented by proprietary packaging systems such as the Reel Payoff®, Cyclone Barrel Pack®, PullPro®, MC Barrel Pack, Reel Deal®, and Reel Payoff® Premium. The campus employs over 1,000 people and supports production for sustainable energy applications including solar, electric vehicle charging, battery storage, wind, and utility transmission.

Encore Wire serves residential, commercial, and industrial construction sectors, as well as renewable energy markets. Its products are used in hospitals, where reliable power is critical, and in everyday infrastructure such as lighting for sports venues and residential charging. The company emphasizes American-made manufacturing and rapid delivery to meet project timelines.

Encore Wire differentiates itself through vertical integration and self-reliance, controlling engineering, manufacturing, and shipping on a single campus. The company highlights its 'whatever it takes' customer service, delivery times, and innovative packaging designed to reduce labor and scrap on job sites. Its TechLab® ensures products meet stringent quality standards before shipment.

name: Endicott Furniture Co Inc
about:
Endicott Furniture Co. Inc. has operated in Concord, New Hampshire, since 1925, when the current owner’s great‑grandfather founded the business. The family‑owned retailer began as a modest furniture store and has grown into a multi‑building showroom spanning more than 20,000 square feet across three floors and seven show floors.

The company sells a broad range of home furnishings — bedroom, living room, dining, home office, and accessories — carrying brands such as New England Made, Amish Made, and Fjords, alongside a curated selection of imports from Canada and other countries. In addition to retail sales, Endicott provides complimentary in‑home decorating services, where staff assist with furniture selection, placement, fabric coordination, floor planning, and color‑flow consultation.

The store serves residential customers throughout New Hampshire and the broader New England region, targeting homeowners and families seeking traditional, country, and Shaker‑style furnishings. Its showroom is designed as a series of accessorized room displays to help shoppers visualize pieces in a home setting.

Endicott emphasizes a no‑pressure, personal shopping experience rooted in long‑term customer relationships; many patrons are described as acquaintances or friends. The business highlights its commitment to Made‑in‑USA furniture while offering imported options for variety and value, and it differentiates itself through free design services and a spacious, multi‑level showroom.
